earth-clouds.jpg
NASA Blue Marble: Clouds
Original asset filename: cloud_combined_2048.jpg
Exact downloaded URL:
https://eoimages.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/imagerecords/57000/57747/cloud_combined_2048.jpg
Original NASA Visible Earth record:
https://visibleearth.nasa.gov/images/57747/blue-marble-clouds/77558l
Dimensions: 2048 x 1024; JPEG; equirectangular grayscale cloud map.
SHA-256: daddaad84d7a33bbbc86cdda3f591099f57cee8607b7bcf3b67eb7e4f7a1c793
Bright areas represent clouds; dark areas can become transparent via alphaMap.
This JPEG does not contain an alpha channel.

Image credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; Reto Stoeckli.
Visualization enhancements: Robert Simmon.
Underlying observations include Terra/MODIS; these are historical composites,
not live weather, and their use in a 3D scene does not make the scene a photograph.
The original NASA Visible Earth webpages now redirect as part of the 2026
Earth Observatory site migration; the NASA GSFC image files remain accessible.
